verdict.rationale: Alacritty documents its own IPC channel, `alacritty msg`, enabled by a config option. The only documented command is `alacritty msg create-window` for opening new windows, so this is a real but very narrow programmatic control surface. missing for 10: documentation of the full IPC command set, any way to send input or read terminal content/state, a richer scripting/remote-control API reference, and independent or hands-on evidence of agents driving it.
